name: helical-platform
description: Compute embeddings and fine-tune Helical foundation models — hosted and billed per token, or locally on your own GPU with the open-source package.

interface.shortDescription: Embed and fine-tune with Helical models
interface.longDescription: Upload single-cell datasets, pick a Helical foundation model, see the per-token cost before you commit, compute embeddings or fine-tune on your own labels, and download the results — or run the same models locally on your own GPU with the open-source helical package, at no cost and without your data leaving your machine.
defaultPrompt: Embed my dataset with a Helical model.
Fine-tune a model on my labelled dataset.
Run a Helical model locally on my own GPU.
